rationale: Although ADMA is holding above session VWAP ($12.36) on 6.43x relative volume following an earnings gap, it is actively pulling back with three consecutive lower lows and lower closes on the 1-minute bars without a stabilization print yet. Combined with a wide 47.7 bps bid-ask spread and a weak broader market (SPY -0.67%, VIXY +3.36%), neither a long entry in the middle of the pullback nor a short against the strong post-earnings trend offers a clean risk-to-reward profile right now.
